metadata.Name: TinyStories
metadata.Description: TinyStories is a synthetic dataset of short stories generated by GPT-3.5 and GPT-4, designed to train and evaluate small language models. The stories use simple vocabulary that a typical 3 to 4-year-old would understand.
metadata.Paper Title: TinyStories: How Small Can Language Models Be and Still Speak Coherent English?
metadata.Abstract: Language models are powerful tools for natural language processing, but they often struggle to produce coherent and fluent text when they are small. In this work, we introduce TinyStories, a synthetic dataset of short stories generated by GPT-3.5 and GPT-4. We show that TinyStories can be used to train and evaluate language models that are much smaller than the state-of-the-art models, yet still produce fluent and consistent stories. We also introduce a new paradigm for the evaluation of language models using GPT-4 to grade the content generated by these models.
